text.en:
The name of the Palawan Teacher’s College in Puerto Princesa City to the Palawan, is changed
to Palawan State College.

The Palawan State College is authorized to continue offering its present collegiate courses and
other courses in arts, sciences and technology.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
